sample_unit: ChatGPT responses to common patient questions about pelvic floor disorders

links.outcome: Flesch Reading Ease readability of ChatGPT responses to pelvic floor disorder patient questions
links.effect: Average readability for all PFDs was 33.57/100, corresponding to a college reading level.
links.quote: The average readability for all PFDs was found to be 33.57/100, corresponding to a college reading level.

links.outcome: Reading level of ChatGPT patient education content versus patient literacy
links.effect: ChatGPT produced content at a college reading level (Flesch Reading Ease 33.57/100), inaccessible to individuals with low health literacy.
links.quote: ChatGPT produces content at a college reading level, which is relatively accurate, of fair to good quality, and reproducible as judged by urogynecologists.

links.outcome: Expert-rated accuracy of ChatGPT responses about pelvic floor disorders
links.effect: Reviewers found content on average 86.71% accurate with 25% variation across responses; median quality 3 to 4 (fair to good).
links.quote: Expert reviewers found that content was on average 86.71% accurate with 25% variation across responses.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT's baseline accuracy, quality, and readability for patient education regarding pelvic floor disorders without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard intervention.
